hints.bridgeDown: {{detalle}}. If this screen does not load, the problem is not one view: the bridge itself is down.
hints.staleBelow: {{detalle}}. What you see below may be out of date.
hints.restOfBoardWorks: The rest of the dashboard keeps working. Switch views and come back to retry.

actions.ERROR_CONNECTION_FAILED: Check that the bridge server is running and that this screen has network access. The «System health» panel tells you which of the two is failing.
actions.ERROR_TIMEOUT: The bridge is alive but took too long. If it keeps happening, check «System health»: it is usually ICONICS answering slowly, not the bridge.
actions.ERROR_READ_ONLY: This is a deployment decision, not a fault: this server started with writing disabled. If it needs to operate the plant, tell whoever deploys it.
actions.ERROR_ACCION_BOMBA: Check the tank level and that the process is enabled; the bridge refuses to start the pump with a high tank. The detail below says which of the two guards tripped.
actions.ERROR_IA_SIN_CONFIGURAR: This deployment has no language model. The dashboard works without it; only the assistant is unavailable.
actions.ERROR_VOZ_SIN_CONFIGURAR: This deployment has no dictation server. Type the question instead.
actions.ERROR_MOTOR_SIN_MONTAR: This deployment has no diagnostics engine. Readings and charts still work.
actions.ERROR_DOCS_SIN_CONFIGURAR: This deployment has no manuals folder. The assistant will answer without being able to cite documentation.
actions.ERROR_PDF_SIN_CONFIGURAR: Exporting is not configured in this deployment. The conversation can be copied by hand in the meantime.
actions.ERROR_PDF_SIN_DEPENDENCIAS: The server is missing a component needed to generate the PDF. Tell whoever deploys it: this cannot be fixed from the dashboard.
actions.ERROR_ARCHIVO_GRANDE: Split the manual into parts, or upload it without the heaviest images. The detail below states the exact limit.
actions.ERROR_AUDIO_GRANDE: Dictate the question in shorter sentences. The detail below states the exact limit.
actions.ERROR_CARGA_DESACTIVADA: This is a deployment decision. Manuals go into the server folder; ask whoever administers it.
